title: Finite-Tor tensor inverse of the intrinsic smooth dualizing object in pure dimension
statement: Fix the purity coefficient datum [def-pur-conventions]: a field $k=\overline{\mathbf F}_q$, a prime $\ell$ different from its characteristic, and a finite coefficient extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$. Let $X,Y$ be finite-type $k$-schemes [def-weil-finite-type-morphism], with no absolute separatedness assumption. Let $g:X\to Y$ be separated, of finite type, and smooth of pure relative dimension $d\in\mathbf N$ [def-sbc-smooth-morphisms]. For $n\in\mathbf N$ put $A=\mathcal O_E/\varpi_E^{n+1}$, let $A_X,A_Y$ be the coefficient units, and let $\omega_g=Rg^!A_Y$ for the actual finite exceptional inverse image [def-weil-exceptional-inverse-image]. Then $\omega_g$ belongs to $D^b_{ctf}(X,A)$ [def-weil-finite-tor-amplitude], and there exists $Q\in D^b_{ctf}(X,A)$ with isomorphisms $\omega_g\otimes_A^L Q\cong A_X$ and $Q\otimes_A^L\omega_g\cong A_X$. The tensor and units are the specified intrinsic coefficient operations [def-weil-derived-pullback-tensor-hom]. The empty source and dimension zero are included; no trivialization or Tate orientation is asserted.

proof.text: Apply [lem-pur-finite-setting-comparison-hypotheses] with level n+1. The target is Noetherian, g is compactifiable, and the finite coefficient quotient has a positive annihilator invertible on the target. [thm-asd-smooth-tensor] identifies the etale exceptional image of the unit with L[2d], where L is etale locally free of rank one.

proof.text: Use [lem-pur-shifted-line-site-inverse] with shift 2d. The comparison images of L[2d] and its dual shifted by -2d are bounded constructible, have finite Tor amplitude, and admit inverse evaluations in both orders. No orientation is chosen, and the empty scheme is allowed.

proof.text: By [def-weil-exceptional-inverse-image], the actual finite exceptional functor is the etale exceptional functor between comparison direct and inverse images. The comparison adjunction unit on the bounded etale coefficient unit identifies its value on the pro-etale unit with the comparison image of L[2d]. Transport the inverse pair through the intrinsic coefficient-module realization. Its K-flat tensor comparison identifies the tensor with the specified finiteIntrinsicDerivedTensor, and the unit with finiteConstantCoefficientObject. The constructibility and Tor predicates are transported by the same equivalence, proving both finiteTorConstructible assertions. The comparison unit is the bounded-below site-comparison theorem [thm-weil-pbc-site-comparison]. The intrinsic realization and scalar restriction are inverse by [lem-sf-intrinsic-realization-origin-comparison]. It preserves the flat terms by [lem-sf-intrinsic-realization-flat]; on tensor representatives the identification is the balanced pure-tensor map, since sections of a constant ring sheaf are locally constant. Extend this map through module sheafification. Apply [lem-sf-cochain-tensor-model-rigidity] with the representative comparison of finiteIntrinsicTensorModels to identify the resulting derived tensor with the recorded one. Apply [lem-sf-intrinsic-comparison-constructibility] and [lem-sf-intrinsic-comparison-tor-amplitude] to the two shifted etale lines, retaining their singleton Tor intervals. These are statements about the actual intrinsic comparison, so both resulting good-object assertions are the finiteTorConstructible predicates of the conclusion.

lean.statement:
theorem smooth_finite_dualizing_inverse (P : PurityFiniteSetting.{u})
    (X Y : Over (Spec (.of P.field.k)))
    [LocallyOfFiniteType (X.left ↘ Spec (.of P.field.k))]
    [QuasiCompact (X.left ↘ Spec (.of P.field.k))]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType (Y.left ↘ Spec (.of P.field.k))]
    [QuasiCompact (Y.left ↘ Spec (.of P.field.k))]
    (g : X.left ⟶ Y.left) [g.IsOver (Spec (.of P.field.k))]
    [IsSeparated g] [LocallyOfFiniteType g] [QuasiCompact g]
    (d n : ℕ) [SmoothOfRelativeDimension d g] :
    let omega := (clopenFiniteExceptional P P.extension X Y g n).obj
      (finiteConstantCoefficientObject P.coefficients.l P.extension Y.left n)
    finiteTorConstructible P.coefficients.l P.extension (n + 1) (Nat.succ_pos n)
        X.left omega ∧
      ∃ Q, finiteTorConstructible P.coefficients.l P.extension (n + 1) (Nat.succ_pos n)
          X.left Q ∧
        Nonempty ((finiteIntrinsicDerivedTensor P.coefficients.l P.extension X.left n).obj
          (omega, Q) ≅ finiteConstantCoefficientObject P.coefficients.l P.extension X.left n) ∧
        Nonempty ((finiteIntrinsicDerivedTensor P.coefficients.l P.extension X.left n).obj
          (Q, omega) ≅ finiteConstantCoefficientObject P.coefficients.l P.extension X.left n)
